dataset.name: chap-core example data: hydro_met_subset
dataset.description: Monthly notified dengue cases and mean temperature for one Brazilian microregion (Adamantina, São Paulo), a subset of Lowe et al. (2021) data, from chap-core example_data. rainfall is a zero placeholder.
dataset.notes: Subset of Lowe et al. 2021, Lancet Planet Health (https://github.com/drrachellowe/hydromet_dengue, data/data_2000_2019.csv) for micro_name Adamantina. Data check: all 240 months match; disease_cases equals dengue_cases (incl. the 12 missing months), mean_temperature equals (tmax + tmin) / 2. Lowe's data has no rainfall, so rainfall is 0 everywhere and is not valid data. Location is an IBGE microregion (a statistical group of municipalities inside a state, not an official admin level); admin_level 2 is the closest level (between state = 1 and municipality). No population column. Dropped the pandas index column (first, unnamed) from the source file; otherwise unchanged.
dataset.schema_status: filled from source code/docs and data checks; not independently verified

source.notes: From Lowe year and month columns.

fields.name: rainfall
fields.description: Placeholder, all values 0. Not rainfall data; do not use.

source.notes: Lowe et al. data has no precipitation column; all 240 values are 0.0.

fields.name: mean_temperature
fields.description: Midpoint of monthly average daily maximum and minimum temperature ((tmax + tmin) / 2), CRU TS 4.04 0.5° grid averaged over the microregion.

source.provider: CRU TS 4.04 via Lowe et al. (2021)
source.notes: data_desc.csv: tmax/tmin are monthly average daily max/min temperature (°C), CRU TS 4.04, exactextractr mean per microregion. Data check: equals (tmax + tmin) / 2 to 4e-15.

fields.name: disease_cases
fields.description: Notified dengue cases (SINAN) in the microregion, by month of first symptoms.

source.provider: SINAN / DATASUS via Lowe et al. (2021)
source.notes: data_desc.csv: dengue_cases = notified cases in SINAN (TabNet). Data check: equals Lowe dengue_cases for all 240 months, same 12 missing.
micro_name 'Adamantina' (IBGE microregion of São Paulo state).
